extracted.stage: Pre-grant; grant of probate expected within 13 weeks, property to be sold
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for executors of a £317k Cheltenham estate enquires about a £32,000 probate loan to cover professional fees and tax pending the sale of the property.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of the executors. We have noted the estate value of £317,000 and the £32,000 requested for professional fees and tax ahead of the property sale. To progress our review, we would be grateful for a breakdown of the estate assets and any liabilities, confirmation of the executors' identities and their consent, the expected inheritance tax position and any HMRC deadline dates, and details of the property and its marketing or sale status. Please also confirm the names of all personal representatives and whether any beneficiary disputes exist. Once we have these, a member of the team will come back to you.
